Two Delhi Police personnel injured during protest detentions

Two Delhi Police personnel, including a member of the Pink Force, were injured near the Kartavya Path and Akashwani Bhawan areas during the detention of protesters. The injuries occurred amidst stone pelting directed at police personnel.
